how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored before the next row (`before` is the shipped source the row was run against, `after` the text that replaced it, so `before` is findable verbatim in `file`). The 16 Jest and JVM rows were run on 2026-11-06 on this checkout at code tree cb51a5a30283, in the gap between the two real-input gates, and each file was restored by the driver (`git status` clean afterwards). The 15 rows added by fix round 1 (the Metro-icon work) were run on 2026-11-07 on this checkout at code tree 34bbc3eb53af, the tree the round ships at, the same way. Rows marked `organic` are not mutations: they are the test going red against the real bug before the fix landed. The `harness:android:Button` / `harness:ios:Button` runs are filtered, so they satisfy nothing but their own name, and each was made against an app rebuilt for that mutation (`node scripts/build-app.mjs --platform android`). Every `harness:android:Button` / `harness:ios:Button` row below has its failing run committed as a scrubbed excerpt in this directory's `failures/` folder, next to `gates.jsonl`. The last row is not a proof either: it is a mutation the suite does NOT catch, recorded so the coverage hole is data rather than an omission.
